name: BIO H▲ZARD - Furangai - Niku to Kokoro o Kurau Machi
original_name: BIO H▲ZARD 腐乱街 肉と心を喰らう街
source:
A town eviscerated by a deadly biological outbreak.
But the world has no idea. A media blackout has kept this teeming hell off the radar of public knowledge.
The mutagen virus that started it all was no research accident.
Engineered for bio warfare by a shadowy agency outside the operating laws of the nation,
it's the key to exposing a much greater conspiracy.
I paid dearly to get information on this town, and now all the residents died in it.
If this is the last days of the city, then it means we can rob as much we want without worring about any trouble in the future.
Well, I hope I can find some woman still alive in the city so that we can have some fun.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103436.html]DLsite English[/url]]
